rule: No rule or prediction here changes after a run. Every config that runs is reported.

inputs.kept_check: kept/ equals Experiment 2's control (hashes in docs/results/phase4/modal/20261026T114520Z/manifest.json) bit for bit on the calibration and boundary-pairs batches, checked again before use

secondary.role: reported beside, chosen after the fact

rows_in_full_request.note: half-open; batches of 8 behind the canary, so batch b holds rows 8(b-1) to 8b-1

replication.threshold_source: refit on kept/ test benign, as planted_faults.md declared

awq_bf16_smoke.prediction: runs; vLLM 0.30.0 routes AWQ to auto_awq, which supports float16 and bfloat16 activations (auto_awq.py:226)
awq_bf16_smoke.if_fails: A2, then C in fp16 with the fp16 arm

bf16_fp8kv_smoke.prediction: engine fails to start on CacheOnlyAttentionLayer's assertion (extract_hidden_states.py:253)
bf16_fp8kv_smoke.if_fails_as_predicted: record the limit in docs/design.md section 10 for capture and live scoring; D is a non-KV config
bf16_fp8kv_smoke.if_starts: no such limit; FP8 KV becomes a candidate for D

arms: unquantized Qwen3-4B in float16 on smoke 64
A2.if_fails: C doesn't run; the plan comes back for a decision

B.config: the full capture's bf16 config on test_batches, canary first, default_rng(1) order

null.note: a single INCONCLUSIVE is within the planted-fault control's 11.8% test miss and isn't the null failing; STALE or DEGRADED is

stop_rules.B0: the container failed or its files didn't verify
stop_rules.B1: B's test rows weren't fed kept/'s prompts and tokens
stop_rules.B2: B's canary isn't cluster 2.0, the bf16 majority path; B is reported as a deviation, isn't used as a floor, and a repeat needs a new go-ahead

C.config: AWQ (model, revision and quantization as A) in bfloat16, or float16 if A2 applies, on c_slice, three replicas kept by batch majority

prediction.replication: THRESHOLD STALE more likely than not
prediction.basis: Phase 1 AWQ on Qwen2.5: INCONCLUSIVE on calibration, STALE on test post hoc (docs/results/phase1/awq_posthoc.md)

stop_rules.C0: a replica failed or its files didn't verify
stop_rules.C1: the replicas weren't fed the same prompts, tokens and metadata, or their tokens differ from kept/'s for the same rows
stop_rules.C2: more than 1% of batches have no majority

C.canary: AWQ has no recorded path; each replica's canary hash is recorded, not checked

C_fp16_arm.only_if: A shows AWQ can't run in bf16
C_fp16_arm.runs: unquantized Qwen3-4B in float16 on c_slice as three replicas kept by batch majority, and one shuffled fp16 rerun, default_rng(1)

awq_alone.role: reported, no verdict claim; check warns if fp16's FPR interval excludes the target, since the thresholds weren't set on fp16

C_fp16_arm.day: can't share a day with C under the $3 guard; runs on a later day

D.decided: after C is read and after A's FP8 KV answer
options: bitsandbytes NF4 at load (needs bitsandbytes in uv.lock)

A.awq_bf16_smoke: as predicted: ran in bfloat16 through auto_awq with MarlinLinearKernel, activations finite
A.bf16_fp8kv_smoke: prediction wrong, unsettled: no assertion, died on missing nvcc under FlashInfer
A.consequence: A2 and C_fp16_arm don't apply; FP8 KV is revisited only if D runs
A.added: 2026-11-09, after the run; no rule or prediction above changed

B.stop_rules: B0, B1 and B2 pass; canary is cluster 2.0
B.added: 2026-11-09, after the run; no rule or prediction above changed
